meta.name: gtars
meta.description: Use Gtars for local genomic interval models and set algebra, overlaps and counts, consensus and coverage, tokenization, fragment processing, and refget/BEDbase planning across Python, Rust, and the CLI.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析基因组区间,找出序列间的重叠与覆盖
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在做基因组科研,需要比较不同区间的对应关系。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze genomic intervals and find overlaps between sequences
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work in genomics and need to compare DNA intervals.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能借助 gtars 处理基因组区间数据：检查区间是否重叠，生成 WIG/BigWig 覆盖轨迹，把基因组位置转换成模型用的 token，也能做参考序列与片段分析。
howto.when: 当用户涉及基因组区间或 BED 文件，要求检测重叠、生成覆盖轨迹、做机器学习 token 化或片段分析时触发。

say.text: 帮我计算这个 BED 文件里两个区间集合的重叠情况。
用这个 fragments.bed 生成 BigWig 覆盖轨迹。
say.note: 调用 uniwig 模块生成轨迹。

say.text: 把这个训练区域文件转成 token 序列。
say.note: 会对每个区域调用 TreeTokenizer。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can process genomic interval data via Gtars: detect overlaps, output WIG/BigWig coverage tracks, tokenize genomic regions for ML, and handle reference/fragment operations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user works with BED files or genomic intervals and requests overlap detection, coverage generation, tokenization, or similar.

say_en.text: Find overlapping regions between these two BED files.
say_en.note: Outputs a BED of overlapping intervals.

say_en.text: Generate a BigWig coverage track from this fragments file.
say_en.note: Runs the uniwig generator on the file.

say_en.text: Tokenize the training regions in this BED file.
say_en.note: Builds a TreeTokenizer and returns tokens.
